**Developing Module Functionality**

My current focus is on elaborating the specific tasks for each user story. I'm detailing the activities required for refactoring the job module lifecycle (U2), updating Spark streaming documentation (U3), and integrating Boot actuator metrics (U4) into the workflow.

I'm now moving to estimate the remaining user stories, U5 through U8, focusing on their specific technical implementations. This involves breaking down tasks for externalized configuration, RabbitMQ performance, and CI build migration, alongside integrating actuator metrics export and comprehensive testing across modules.

technical_and_design_decisions: Leverage Spring Boot Actuator's MetricRepository auto-configuration and export API for metrics consumption.
Utilize Spring Boot's ConfigurationMetadataReader and PropertySource abstraction to handle Spring XD module options.
Adopt Spring Cloud Config / Spring Environment external property source patterns for XD-Admin and XD-Container servers.
Implement on-demand application context bootstrapping using Spring XD Job Launch Listeners and destroy contexts upon job execution completion.
Use AWS EC2 infrastructure with automated setup scripts (Terraform/Ansible or AMI templates) for Jenkins/CI master build agents.
assumptions: A single senior software developer will execute all implementation, configuration, benchmarking, and documentation tasks.
An existing Spring XD cluster test environment is available for running benchmarks and RabbitMQ performance troubleshooting.
AWS EC2 accounts and credentials with adequate permissions are available for CI migration.
Development work is based on standard Spring Framework 6 / Spring Boot 3 baseline where applicable, compatible with Java 17+.

activities.activity_description: Analyze technical requirements across all user stories (U1-U8), design lifecycle event hooks for job modules, and plan configuration management changes.

activities.activity_name: Spring XD Cluster Benchmarking & Infrastructure Documentation (U1)
activities.activity_description: Setup reference XD clusters, execute performance benchmark suites, capture infrastructure metrics, and publish benchmark reference documentation.
Modify job module lifecycle to bootstrap ApplicationContext upon job launch and trigger context shutdown upon job completion.

activities.activity_name: Spark Streaming Documentation & Example Code Updates (U3)
activities.activity_description: Update sample applications to show tap usage on Spark module outputs and write technical documentation covering Reliable receivers.

activities.activity_name: Spring Boot Actuator Metric Export API Integration (U4)
activities.activity_description: Integrate Boot Actuator's MetricRepository export API into module metrics pipeline to expose application metrics directly.

activities.activity_name: Module Options Boot PropertySource & Metadata Refactoring (U5)
activities.activity_description: Refactor module option parsing to use Spring Boot metadata injection and property sources, deprecating legacy core XD classpath option handling.

activities.activity_name: Centralized External Configuration for XD Servers (U6)
activities.activity_description: Implement server and client-side support for externalized configuration across XD-Admin and XD-Container instances across environments.

activities.activity_name: RabbitMQ Message Bus Performance Troubleshooting & Tuning (U7)
activities.activity_description: Profile RabbitMQ message bus under peak loads, identify throughput bottlenecks, adjust concurrency/acknowledgment settings, and validate fixes.

activities.activity_name: CI Master Branch Migration to EC2 Infrastructure (U8)
activities.activity_description: Provision EC2 CI build agents, migrate master branch build pipelines, verify build execution and test reporting reliability.
Perform end-to-end regression and integration testing across modified components, modules, and deployment configurations.
